    "Remove the redundant white 'Obiščite nas' address section at the bottom, as the exact same address and directions link already appear in the dark contact block right above it.",
    "Remove the second 'Navodila za pot' link below the hero CTA button, since it is already prominently placed in the header and the location isn't mentioned in the hero.",
    "On desktop, shift the socket illustration slightly to the right or shorten the top brown wire so the headline 'Elektroinštalacije' does not touch the graphic."

    "On both phone and desktop, the physical address and 'Navodila za pot' link are repeated consecutively in the dark contact section and the white 'Obiščite nas' block immediately below it."
